description: A flock of Hyderabad hackers building a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, so anyone can see and map the stars. And... We’re recruiting! Coders, designers, storytellers, space nerds, physics nerds, and anyone who can explain orbits to a 10-year-old effectively are welcome. No astronaut credentials required. Bring curiosity, snacks, and a tolerance for pigeon puns. Join us and help the next generation reach for the stars (and not get stuck in the airlock).
